about: Attack/technique names for the Hebrew One Pace subs. he = the Hebrew to use. Gum-Gum moves use the fan-manga prefix "גומו גומו נו..." + noun; the Six Powers and Haki use "Japanese (Hebrew)". status: owner (owner ruling), agreed (strong human sources agree), conflict (they disagree; he follows precedence), house / house-inconsistent (no human source; our most common rendering), weak (only forum or reader-comment usage), untranslated (no Hebrew anywhere yet), proposed (agent proposal, owner to review), policy (owner style rule), split / not-an-attack (needs a hand fix), chosen (final pick after a Fable 5.1 naturalness review; the owner delegated it). calls = times called in our subs (0 = only in outside sources). Rebuild: python3 scripts/build-attack-names.py. Research 2026-11-07.
